description: The right dock sits on the right side of a vertical surface 108px wide, with four icons ordered top to bottom.

assertions.comment: The right dock requests a vertical surface with calculated width 108px and output height 768px
The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) is at x=36 on the 108px surface, accounting for the 64px panel and 8px margin
The right vertical panel is centered at y=274, which is (768-220)/2
The right vertical panel width is 64px
The right vertical panel height is 220px, including four items, spacing, and padding
The calculated right-edge position for the unnamed panel path is 36px
Right dock icons have increasing y coordinates from top to bottom
The right vertical dock’s DockItem width is 56px
The right vertical dock’s DockItem height is 48px
